description: Sample-room sewing cell: two FR3 arms with Franka Hands at an industrial single-needle lockstitch machine (Juki DDL-9000C class). Lay two muslin plies under the presser foot, join them with a plain seam 10 mm from their edges with backtacks at both ends, baste with the 5 mm stitch, turn a corner with the needle down, or steer a seam around a rounded corner; the machine is driven through its control box (pedal speed, needle stop, presser lift, touch-back reverse, trimmer). Feeding, puncture, needle deflection and strikes, loop pickup, stitch formation and thread tension come from the physics.
count_scope: Nine named tasks in the sample-room preset, seeds 0-9: the first five tasks use variation ids 0-49 and the four others 50-89. task_set lists the eight exact selections; baste is registered outside that set.

variation_catalogue.selection: at launch: gar run sewing --variation N (or --select variation_id=N; a task or seed given beside it must be the entry's); in a session: GET /v1/variations; POST /v1/variations/start, or reset with options {variation_id}; variation_id = task index x 10 + seed
variation_catalogue.notes: 9 tasks x seeds 0-9; original entries 0-49 unchanged. Optional contract selects revised load/plain-seam/pivot. square-plies uses a separate slipped-start cache; other new starts reuse existing physics configurations.

evaluator.scope: Physical state only: the machine's stitch ledger in the plies' material coordinates (seam line, stitch length and density, skips, backtacks, balance, tucks), ply corners (ends meet, alignment), seam-band heights (pucker), the needle's state, thread breaks and trimming, robot reflexes and the hands' contact with the cloth. No autonomous-solution claim.

qualification: Components are qualified by probes and assisted demonstrations.

task_set.qualification: Checked in code and with stubbed states only. The four new tasks and the revised load, plain-seam and pivot judgements are not yet run with the simulator or rendered, and no success rate is measured.

omitted.baste: The needle bends by stitch 25-32 at the 6 mm allowance; baste stays in the catalogue.

task_set.contract_selection: Bare existing selections keep sewing-v1 (curve keeps its own sewing-curve-v1 contract, unchanged). The task_set explicitly selects sewing-tasks-v1 for load/plain-seam/pivot. New tasks use that contract by default. Task ids remain stable; every evaluation reports task_contract.
